name: Robe of Eyes
description: A robe covered in embroidered eyes that sometimes blink.
body:
## What it does

The eyes see in every direction at once and through the dark, and they see what is invisible or out on the Ethereal Plane within 120 feet. A light spell cast on the robe, or a daylight spell cast within 5 feet of it, blinds you for a minute.

features.name: All Eyes
features.text: You see in every direction, and you see invisible creatures and objects and into the Ethereal Plane out to 120 feet.

features.name: Blinded
features.text: A light spell cast on the robe, or a daylight spell cast within 5 feet of it, blinds you for a minute.
